android_dial_connect_at_mode: Button in the add-host sheet. mode: the stream size and refresh rate, e.g. 1920×1080@60.
android_error_connect_check_address: A connect failed for a reason with no sentence of its own.
android_local_network_hint: “Nearby devices” is the name of Android's own permission; use the system's translation.
android_local_network_title: Title of the dialog before Android's nearby-devices permission prompt.
android_profile_starting_hint: Under 'Getting {name}'s desk ready…' while a profile's desktop starts.
android_trust_fingerprint: The start of the host's certificate fingerprint, in hex.
android_unlock_use_password: Button in Android's fingerprint sheet that falls back to typing the password.
android_unlock_with_fingerprint: Switch in the password prompt on a phone with a fingerprint reader.
android_lnp_allow: Button that asks Android for local network access.
android_hostcard_trust_pin_a11y: TalkBack label of a host card's trust badge: the host pairs with a PIN.
android_hostcard_connect_with_preset: Menu item. {preset} is the preset's name.
android_hostcard_pin_as_card: Menu item. {preset} is the preset's name.
android_hostcard_unpin_card: Menu item. {preset} is the preset's name.
android_speedtest_target_preset_body: Speed test note. {preset} is the preset's name.
android_speedtest_target_ask_body: Speed test note. {preset} is the preset's name.
android_mgmt_unreachable: Cause phrase after a frame's dash, when a management call got no answer. Lowercase, no period.
android_lib_identity_unavailable: Library page when this device's pairing identity can't be loaded.
android_lib_error_unpaired_first: Cause phrase after 'Couldn't load the library — '. Lowercase, no period.
android_lib_error_tls: Cause phrase after a frame's dash.
android_lib_error_unreachable: Cause phrase after a frame's dash.
android_lib_error_host_unpaired: Cause phrase after 'Couldn't end {title} — ' and similar frames.
android_ring_screens: Quick action on a dual-screen handheld: step where the picture and the companion panel go.
android_ring_screens_note: Note under Screens in the action picker.
android_ring_keyboard_not_granted: Why the keyboard and shortcut actions are dimmed.
android_ring_send_text_unsupported: Why Send text is dimmed: the host has no text input.
android_send_text_title: Title of the dialog that types text to the host.
android_console_unavailable_failed: Footer under the controller interface switch. ⋮ is the overflow menu icon on a host card.
android_prefs_show_advanced_settings: Subtitle of the advanced-changed row; tapping it shows the hidden settings.
android_player_overlay_actions_opener: First line of the Quick actions explainer. button is the system Back key, keys the keyboard chord (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+O), pad_keys the controller chord (Select + A).
android_player_back_opens_ring: Android-only switch. Back is the system Back key, named here because it is what the setting is about.
android_player_back_opens_ring_hint: button is the system Back key.
android_keyboard_shortcuts: Row that opens the accessibility setting for capturing every keyboard shortcut.
android_keyboard_shortcuts_on: The same row while the key capture service runs.
android_keyboard_shortcuts_on_hint: Subtitle while the key capture service runs. Alt+Tab and the Windows key are what the service is for: keep them.
android_keyboard_shortcuts_hint: Subtitle while the service is off. Accessibility is the name of Android's settings page.
android_prefs_controllers: Row that opens the screen listing the controllers this device sees.
android_preset_manage_a11y: Accessibility label of a preset chip's menu button. name is the preset's name.
android_preset_menu_edit: Preset chip menu: edit the preset's name and color.
android_preset_edit_hint: Under the name field while editing a preset.
android_preset_swatch_a11y: Accessibility label of a colored swatch.
android_preset_binding: Label of the host editor's preset dropdown.
android_preset_pinned_cards: Heading in the host editor over the presets pinned to this host.
android_about_components_intro: Second sentence on the licenses screen, after about_license_statement.
android_keycapture_title: Disclosure dialog before the accessibility key capture service.
android_keycapture_agree: Button; the dialog's last paragraph names it.
android_keycapture_body_why: AccessibilityService is an API name: keep it.
android_keycapture_body_how: Agree is android_keycapture_agree; Punktfunk keyboard shortcuts is android_keycapture_service_label.
android_keycapture_service_label: The accessibility service's name in Android's Accessibility settings.
android_keycapture_service_description: The service's description in Android's Accessibility settings.
android_remote_pointer_hint: Cue on Android TV while the remote drives the host's cursor. select, play_pause = the remote keys' names, e.g. 'SELECT', 'play/pause'.
android_grant_expired: Toast when a stream ends because this device's timed access ran out.
android_keepalive_streaming: Ongoing notification text while a stream runs in the foreground with no mode line yet.
android_keepalive_background: Ongoing notification text while the app is in the background and the stream is kept alive.
android_keepalive_end_now: Notification button while backgrounded: ends the stream before its countdown does.
android_keepalive_end_stream: Notification button: ends the running stream.
android_keepalive_channel: Name of the notification channel in Android's app settings.
android_keepalive_channel_desc: Description of the notification channel in Android's app settings.
android_graph_frame_rate: Companion panel stats: tile and chart title.
android_graph_latency: Companion panel stats: tile and chart title.
android_graph_bitrate: Companion panel stats: tile and chart title.
android_graph_loss: Companion panel stats: tile title (lost frames in percent).
android_graph_of_refresh: Companion panel Frame rate tile, under the presented fps. rate = the display refresh in Hz, a bare number, e.g. '120'.
android_graph_capture_to_glass: Companion panel Latency tile caption before the first sample: what the number measures.
android_graph_received: Companion panel chart legend: received frames per second.
android_graph_presented: Companion panel chart legend: presented frames per second.
android_graph_refresh: Companion panel chart: label on the display-refresh reference line, followed by its number.
android_graph_goodput: Companion panel Bitrate chart legend: useful data received.
android_graph_target: Companion panel Bitrate chart: label on the target-bitrate reference line, followed by its number.
android_graph_now: Companion panel chart: right end of the time axis, and the readout's time for the newest sample.
android_graph_seconds_ago: Companion panel chart readout for a touched sample. seconds = whole seconds.
android_companion_stats: Companion panel page (second screen or the hinge's lower half).
android_companion_actions: Companion panel page: the quick actions.
android_companion_controller: Companion panel page: the virtual controller.
android_companion_layout_panel: Two-screen layout option: the picture above, the panel below.
android_companion_layout_swapped: Two-screen layout option: the panel above, the picture below.
android_companion_layout_spanned: Two-screen layout option: one picture across both screens.
android_companion_view_text: Companion panel stats view option: the overlay's lines.
android_companion_stats_waiting: Companion panel stats page before the first window closes.
android_companion_group_session: Companion panel Actions page: group heading.
android_companion_group_host: Companion panel Actions page: group heading.
android_companion_group_leave: Companion panel Actions page: group heading over End game, End stream and Disconnect.
android_companion_armed_a11y: Screen-reader state of an action tile that needs a second press.
android_companion_trackpad_hint: Companion panel Trackpad page: the gestures it understands.
android_companion_show_controller: Companion panel Controller page: button that shows the virtual controller.
android_pad_none_detected: Controllers screen when no pad is detected. 'Other input devices' quotes android_pad_group_other.
android_pad_test_inputs: Controllers screen: the input-test switch's label.
android_pad_test_idle: Caption under 'Test inputs' while the test is off.
android_pad_test_running: Caption under 'Test inputs' while the test runs. button = the pad's back button name, e.g. 'B'.
android_pad_test_release: Caption under 'Test inputs' once the hold is long enough. button = the pad's back button name, e.g. 'B'.
android_pad_group_other: Controllers screen group heading: keyboards, mice and other non-pad devices.
android_pad_other_none: Under 'Other input devices' when there are none.
android_pad_sc2_bt_paired: Steam Controller 2 row when one is paired over Bluetooth but not granted.
android_pad_grant_bluetooth: Button on the Steam Controller 2 Bluetooth row.
android_pad_navigating_ui: Badge on a Steam Controller row while it drives the app's menus.
android_pad_paired_bluetooth: How a Steam Controller is connected.
android_pad_wireless_dongle: How a Steam Controller is connected.
android_pad_puck_dongle: How a Steam Controller 2 is connected. 'Puck' is the dongle's product name.
android_pad_sc_captured: Steam Controller row once captured. name = 'Steam Controller' or 'Steam Controller 2'.
android_pad_rumble_sent: Toast after 'Test rumble' on a Steam Controller row.
android_pad_rumble_unreachable: Toast after 'Test rumble' when nothing answered.
android_pad_test_rumble: Button on a controller row: pulses its motors.
android_pad_needs_usb: Steam Controller row when wired but not granted.
android_pad_grant_usb: Button on a wired controller row.
android_pad_detected: Steam Controller row when wired and granted.
android_pad_passthrough_title: Title of a wired Sony pad's row. model = 'DualSense', 'DualSense Edge' or 'DualShock 4'.
android_pad_passthrough_disabled: Wired Sony pad row when the setting is off. The quoted name is the setting's label.
android_pad_needs_usb_grant: Wired Sony pad row when not yet granted.
android_pad_haptics_passed: Result of the DualSense haptics self-test. count = audio frames that reached the pad.
android_pad_haptics_open_failed: Result of the DualSense haptics self-test.
android_pad_haptics_stopped: Result of the DualSense haptics self-test.
android_pad_haptics_silent: Result of the DualSense haptics self-test.
android_pad_haptics_testing: The haptics test button while it runs.
android_pad_test_haptics: Button on a wired DualSense row.
android_pad_forwarded_player: Badge on a pad row. number = Android's controller number, 1-based.
android_pad_forwarded: Badge on a pad row when Android has not numbered it.
android_pad_streams_as_auto: Pad row. kind = the controller model the host sees, e.g. 'DualSense'.
android_pad_streams_as_set: Pad row when Controller type is set by hand. kind = the chosen model; auto = what Automatic would pick. Both are model names.
android_pad_layout_playstation: Pad row note when a button correction is in force.
android_pad_layout_xbox: Pad row note when a button correction is in force.
android_pad_layout_corrected: Pad row note when a button correction is in force.
android_pad_no_motor: Toast or console notice after a rumble test that reached no motor.
android_pad_no_rumble_motors: Pad row when Android reports no vibrator for the pad.
android_pad_bt_already: Console notice after the Steam Controller 2 Bluetooth grant row.
android_pad_ds_enable_passthrough: Console notice after the DualSense USB grant row. The quoted name is the setting's label.
android_pad_ds_none: Console notice after the DualSense USB grant row.
android_pad_usb_already: Console notice after a USB grant row.
android_pad_dualsense_none: Console notice after the haptics test row.
android_pad_ds4_no_haptics: Console notice after the haptics test row.
android_pad_grant_usb_first: Console notice after the haptics test row.
android_pad_detail_captured: Detail on a captured Steam Controller's card in the console Controllers tab, read out with the pad.
android_console_unavailable: Notice when Controller-optimized UI is on but this build ships no console.
android_console_failed: Notice when the console failed to start. ⋮ is the menu glyph.
android_already_streaming: Toast when a link or shortcut asks for another host while a stream runs.
android_launcher_saved: Toast after saving a launcher file for a host or game.
android_launcher_save_failed: Toast when writing a launcher file failed.
android_save_dialog_failed: Toast when Android offers no document picker.
android_link_file_unreadable: Toast when an opened launcher file holds no link.
android_overlay_app_capped: Stats overlay warning line (Android). rate = the refresh the system holds the app to, a whole number.
android_overlay_panel_rate: Stats overlay warning line (Android). rate = the panel's measured refresh; stream_rate = the stream's; both whole numbers.
